  • Method Details

    • getCurrentPet

      public Animal getCurrentPet()
      Method to get the current pet the user has 'selected', by the index of the selected pet.
      Returns:
      type Animal - return the animal object the user has selected (whether cat or dog)

    • nextPet

      public void nextPet()
      Method to get the 'next pet' in the pet array. Works by incrementing the current index, until the size of the index, then resets to 0 (the first pet)

    • previousPet

      public void previousPet()
      Method to get the 'previous pet' in the array. Works by decrementing the current index, until the first index in the array, then resets to the last pet in the array

    • addPet

      public void addPet(Animal pet)
      Method to add a new pet
      Parameters:
      pet - - when called, takes in a type of Animal and adds that animal to the array

    • addPet

      public void addPet(String name, int age, String description, String petType)
      Second 'addPet' function - calls the first 'addPet' function (above)
      Parameters:
      name - - the name of the pet
      age - - the age of the pet
      description - - a description of the pet
      petType - - the type of pet (whether cat or dog, for example) Takes n the above parameters and removes whitespace from name and description. Checks the type of pet can creates a new pet of the designated type, with the details from the above parameters

    • currentPetSleep

      public void currentPetSleep(int hours)
      Method to make the 'current pet' sleep
      Parameters:
      hours - - the number of hours the user wants the pet to sleep

    • currentPetFeed

      public void currentPetFeed(int amount)
      Method to feed the 'current pet'
      Parameters:
      amount - - the amount of food the user wants to feed the pet

    • timePass

      public void timePass()
      The method to pass time. Calls the individual pet's designated 'timePass' function This is done because of different animal's different needs; dogs, for example, will get hungrier in the same amount of time than cats will.
